name: JxionWeb
description: Jxion Web Application from Jxion Team

scripts.serve:kitup-case-study: cd apps/kitUP-case-study && PORT=3007 npm run dev
scripts.serve:main: concurrently "npm run serve:noir-crafted" "npm run serve:noir-admin" "npm run serve:jxion-react" "npm run serve:kitup-case-study" --names "noir-crafted,noir-admin,jxion-react,kitup-case-study" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow,cyan"
scripts.serve:all: concurrently "npm run serve:noir-crafted" "npm run serve:noir-admin" "npm run serve:jxion-react" "npm run serve:jxion-api" "npm run serve:jxion-vue" "npm run serve:jxion-svelte" "npm run serve:jxion-solidjs" "npm run serve:jxion-frontend" "npm run serve:jxion-angular" "npm run serve:kitup-case-study" --names "noir-crafted,noir-admin,jxion-react,jxion-api,jxion-vue,jxion-svelte,jxion-solidjs,jxion-frontend,jxion-angular,kitup-case-study" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta,white,gray,brightBlue,brightGreen"
